stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let $p$ be a point of $\mathcal{C}$ given by
$u : \mathcal{C} \to \textit{Sets}$. Let $U$ be an object of $\mathcal{C}$
and let $x \in u(U)$. The functor
$$
v : \mathcal{C}/U \longrightarrow \textit{Sets}, \quad
(\varphi : V \to U) \longmapsto \{y \in u(V) \mid u(\varphi)(y) = x\}
$$
defines a point $q$ of the site $\mathcal{C}/U$ such that the diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
& \Sh(pt) \ar[d]^p \ar[ld]_q \\
\Sh(\mathcal{C}/U) \ar[r]^{j_U} &
\Sh(\mathcal{C})
}
$$
commutes. In other words
$\mathcal{F}_p = (j_U^{-1}\mathcal{F})_q$ for any
sheaf on $\mathcal{C}$.

sheaf on $\mathcal{C}$.

reason: Represent p by its small site of sets and localize at x∈u(U). The constant-map functor into Sets/u(U) has continuous right adjoint selecting fibres at x; its composite with localized u gives exactly the claimed point q, and the constructed topos square proves stalk compatibility.

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site, let $p$ be a point of $\mathcal{C}$ given by a functor $u:\mathcal{C}\to\textit{Sets}$, and let $U\in\Ob(\mathcal{C})$. Let $j_U:\Sh(\mathcal{C}/U)\to\Sh(\mathcal{C})$ be the localization morphism of topoi.
There is a one-to-one correspondence between $x\in u(U)$ and points $q$ of $\mathcal{C}/U$ with $j_U\circ q=p$. The point corresponding to $x$ is represented by the functor $(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}U)\mapsto\{y\in u(V)\mid u(\varphi)(y)=x\}$ on $\mathcal{C}/U$.
hypotheses: Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site, let $p$ be a point of $\mathcal{C}$ given by a functor $u:\mathcal{C}\to\textit{Sets}$, and let $U\in\Ob(\mathcal{C})$. Let $j_U:\Sh(\mathcal{C}/U)\to\Sh(\mathcal{C})$ be the localization morphism of topoi.
conclusions: There is a one-to-one correspondence between $x\in u(U)$ and points $q$ of $\mathcal{C}/U$ with $j_U\circ q=p$. The point corresponding to $x$ is represented by the functor $(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}U)\mapsto\{y\in u(V)\mid u(\varphi)(y)=x\}$ on $\mathcal{C}/U$.

reason: For any point q over p, pull back the cartesian square of slice representables and restrictions along the exact q^{-1}. The resulting square gives v(V/U) as the fibre of u(V)→u(U) at the unique element x determined by q(U/U), proving uniqueness of the point and the stated correspondence.

Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let $p$ be a point of $\mathcal{C}$ given by
$u : \mathcal{C} \to \textit{Sets}$. Let $U$ be an object of $\mathcal{C}$.
For any sheaf $\mathcal{G}$ on $\mathcal{C}/U$ we have
$$
(j_{U!}\mathcal{G})_p =
\coprod\nolimits_q \mathcal{G}_q
$$
where the coproduct is over the points $q$ of $\mathcal{C}/U$
associated to elements $x \in u(U)$ as in
Lemma \ref{lemma-point-localize}.
